description: Device chains (sync-v2.md §14): schedules of served records and what the chain verifier reports for each. `server` lists what `GET .../chain/{device}/{counter}` serves (the record at that counter or the device's next one above it), `start_heads` the heads a bootstrap checkpoint gave, and `expect` either the verdict of each record of each page or the error and the page and index where it occurs. A `checkpoint_walk` case (§17, Checkpoint chain) gives the checkpoints a client `reached`, its `floor` and restore `generation`, the checkpoints `GET .../checkpoints/{digest}` serves, and a page's `entries`, and `expect` lists the checkpoints the client fetches before each entry, oldest first, or the index of the entry where the walk reports `sync_chain_gap`. A `fork_resolution` case gives the pages a reader `applied`, the page that `forked`, the head the first checkpoint covering the change that ends the device's write access `kept`, and the log's `records` from the reader's cursor through that checkpoint's `covered_seq`, with `accepted_covered_seq` when the reader accepted a checkpoint after the applied pages; `expect` holds the verdicts of the forked page judged again once the fork settles, with the digests of the applied records settling `reverted` when the fork point lies below the reader's head, or the error settling reports.
